name: Keyho
shortDescription: Property operations platform connecting owners, managers and workers.
description: KEYHO is an integrated operations platform for multi-unit property portfolios. It bridges owners, property managers, on-site contractors and operational staff into a unified, synchronized dashboard for task assignment, status verification, and work auditing.
tagline: Streamline property workflows with zero operational latency.

capabilities.title: Task Dispatch & Assignment
capabilities.description: Auto-allocate maintenance and operational tasks based on worker availability, proximity and specialty.

capabilities.title: Apartment & Asset Tracking
capabilities.description: Comprehensive unit-level history, inventory tracking and condition reporting with photographic logs.

capabilities.title: Worker Communication Gateway
capabilities.description: Direct mobile-friendly messaging and notification dispatch without third-party app installations.

capabilities.title: Auditable Financial & Service Logs
capabilities.description: Immutable operational records ready for accounting exports and owner transparent billing.

name: Telemetry Hub
shortDescription: Unified metrics, logs, traces and alerting for Docker Compose environments.
description: TELEMETRY HUB is an all-in-one observability platform designed specifically for self-hosted and independent Docker Compose architectures. It consolidates metrics collection, structured log streaming, trace aggregation, and smart alert rules into a single lean stack.
tagline: Turn distributed container noise into actionable operational clarity.

capabilities.title: Lightweight Log Streaming
capabilities.description: Instant ingestion of container stdout/stderr with full-text search, regex filtering, and tag indexing.

capabilities.title: Multi-service Metric Graphs
capabilities.description: Auto-scrapes Prometheus endpoints and host resources (CPU, RAM, IOPS, Network) without heavy agents.

capabilities.title: Smart Anomaly Alerting
capabilities.description: Threshold and rate-of-change alerts dispatched to Telegram, Discord, Slack or custom webhooks.

capabilities.title: Trace Propagation
capabilities.description: Correlate user requests across microservices with distributed OpenTelemetry context propagation.

name: Job Follow
shortDescription: Automated lead monitoring, news feeds and IT job discovery engine.
description: JOB FOLLOW monitors Telegram channels, job boards, community forums and news distribution outlets in real time. It uses custom natural language classifiers to extract high-value leads, technical vacancies, and market signals, delivering them instantly to tailored feeds.
tagline: Continuous intelligence from high-velocity communication channels.

capabilities.title: Telegram Channel Ingestion
capabilities.description: Connects multiple listener accounts to extract messages across public and restricted technical groups.

capabilities.title: Contextual Lead Scoring
capabilities.description: Applies neural classifiers to filter out spam and prioritize relevant job opportunities or business leads.

capabilities.title: Structured Resume Matching
capabilities.description: Cross-checks vacancy requirements against developer profiles to calculate precise qualification scores.

capabilities.title: Multi-target Dispatch
capabilities.description: Route scored opportunities into personal Telegram bots, Notion boards, or webhook endpoints.

name: Chpokai
shortDescription: Authorized AI-agent security, pentesting and acceptance testing platform.
description: CHPOKAI executes controlled, reproducible behavioral security assessments against web systems, APIs and AI agents. It identifies prompt injections, business logic bypasses, auth leakage, and API flaws, generating auditable proof-of-exploit reports.
tagline: Autonomous adversarial verification with machine-readable evidence.

capabilities.title: Autonomous Attack Simulation
capabilities.description: Generates non-destructive exploitation vectors testing for OWASP Top 10 for LLMs and web APIs.

capabilities.title: Sandbox Execution Proofs
capabilities.description: Isolates findings with step-by-step reproduction traces and verifiable network payloads.

capabilities.title: Guardrail Regression Testing
capabilities.description: Continuously asserts that system prompts and safety filters maintain their integrity across model updates.

capabilities.title: Machine-Readable Audit Reports
capabilities.description: Exports formal vulnerability logs in JSON, Markdown, and SARIF formats for CI/CD integration.

name: Activity Simulator
shortDescription: Native desktop application orchestrating realistic mouse, keyboard and scenario behaviors.
description: Activity Simulator is a native cross-platform desktop application (macOS, Windows, Linux) that orchestrates desktop workflows with natural bezier mouse curves, randomized typing cadence, and adaptive window management. Built for stress testing, realistic activity generation, and autonomous scenario execution.
tagline: Natural desktop automation with realistic human-like dynamics and native OS hooks.

capabilities.title: Natural Bezier Pointer Curves
capabilities.description: Simulates realistic cursor movement acceleration, deceleration, and micro-corrections.

capabilities.title: Stochastic Typing Cadence
capabilities.description: Dynamic character entry speeds with simulated fatigue, pauses, and typo-correction behavior.

capabilities.title: Multi-window Application Flow
capabilities.description: Intelligently manages browser tabs, code editors, and terminal focus across long-running sessions.

capabilities.title: Profile & Scenario Presets
capabilities.description: Save custom developer, researcher, or operator profiles with distinct daily schedule patterns.

name: Build Runner
shortDescription: Real-time cross-platform desktop interview and engineering copilot.
description: BUILD RUNNER is a native cross-platform desktop application (macOS & Windows) that listens to audio discussions and analyzes screen context simultaneously. It operates as a stealth floating HUD overlay, providing architectural suggestions, live syntax hints, and algorithmic breakdowns in real time.
tagline: Realtime multimodal desktop copilot combining voice, screen context, and stealth HUD overlay.

capabilities.title: Real-time Audio Stream Parsing
capabilities.description: High-accuracy continuous voice transcription with speaker diarization and noise suppression.

capabilities.title: Live Screen Context OCR
capabilities.description: Reads technical problem statements, IDE code windows, and system architecture diagrams on the fly.

capabilities.title: Role-Aware Response Synthesis
capabilities.description: Tailors advice to senior engineering levels, avoiding boilerplate in favor of architectural precision.

capabilities.title: Stealth Floating HUD
capabilities.description: Transparent, click-through desktop overlay designed for absolute minimum visual distraction.

architecture.deployment: Client Desktop with Cloud AI Bridge

name: Key Service
shortDescription: Licensing, device-bound verification and entitlement infrastructure.
description: Key Service is a high-performance Go/PostgreSQL licensing backend. It handles cryptographic product activation, hardware fingerprint hashing, recurring entitlement validation, and audited lifecycle administration across all studio applications.
tagline: Hardware-bound licensing and entitlement control for software products.

capabilities.title: Device-Bound Fingerprinting
capabilities.description: Hashes CPU, motherboard, and disk IDs to create tamper-resistant device identity hashes.

capabilities.title: Cryptographic License Keys
capabilities.description: Issues Ed25519-signed license tokens verifiable both online and in air-gapped environments.

capabilities.title: Feature Entitlement Gates
capabilities.description: Granular boolean, integer and expiration-based feature toggles per issued license.

capabilities.title: Audit & Revocation Control
capabilities.description: Instantly revoke, rebind, or suspend licenses with an immutable administrative audit trail.

name: AI Execution Advisor
shortDescription: Analyzes AI workloads, execution cost and quality for organizational LLM ops.
description: Observes organization-scoped AI workloads across providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, local open weights). Analyzes token efficiency, cache hit rates, prompt length bloat, and provides guarded A/B experiment recommendations to cut costs without reducing quality.
tagline: Evidence-based cost, latency, and quality optimization for enterprise AI.

capabilities.title: Cross-Provider Cost Inspection
capabilities.description: Granular per-tenant, per-model, and per-feature spend tracking down to the individual token.

capabilities.title: Prompt Compression & Caching
capabilities.description: Detects repetitive context blocks and enforces prefix caching rules to slash LLM billings by up to 60%.

capabilities.title: A/B Quality Evaluation
capabilities.description: Guarded side-by-side model experiments benchmarking smaller/cheaper models against flagship tiers.

capabilities.title: Adaptive Fallback Policy
capabilities.description: Auto-reroutes failed or rate-limited requests to standby providers with zero user disruption.

name: Agent Platform
shortDescription: Multi-tenant control plane for agents, conversations, tools and delegations.
description: A scalable multi-tenant control plane for orchestrating autonomous agents, persistent memories, tool registries, execution quotas, and cross-agent delegation across web, Telegram, voice and media pipelines.
tagline: The unified operating system for autonomous enterprise agents.

capabilities.title: Hierarchical Agent Delegation
capabilities.description: Supervisor agents break complex goals into task graphs and delegate to specialized subagents.

capabilities.title: Sandboxed Tool Execution
capabilities.description: Execute Python, Bash, Web Search, and database queries in short-lived secure micro-VM environments.

capabilities.title: Contextual Memory Management
capabilities.description: Short-term sliding window context coupled with long-term vector embeddings and user facts graph.

capabilities.title: Tenant Quotas & Policy Controls
capabilities.description: Fine-grained rate limits, budget ceilings, and strict tool authorization policies per workspace.

name: Voice AI
shortDescription: Realtime bidirectional conversational agents for voice and telephony.
description: Realtime conversational voice engine combining WebRTC streaming, acoustic voice activity detection (VAD), streaming neural speech-to-text, LLM generation, and ultra-low-latency voice synthesis.
tagline: Sub-second conversational voice intelligence with natural interruption handling.

capabilities.title: Bilingual Speech Pipeline
capabilities.description: Flawless transcription and synthesis across Ukrainian and English with native accent modulation.

capabilities.title: Zero-lag Barge-in
capabilities.description: User interruptions are recognized instantly, gracefully silencing current audio playback within 80ms.

capabilities.title: Telephony & WebRTC Connectors
capabilities.description: Connect directly to Asterisk, Twilio, browser WebRTC, or SIP trunks.

capabilities.title: Custom Voice Personas
capabilities.description: Train and configure distinct vocal characteristics, pacing, emotion, and technical tone.

name: Video AI
shortDescription: Generative video editing, synthetic presentations and avatar experiences.
description: Generative video pipeline for producing product demos, synthetic avatar presentations, and automated short-form video content from structured markdown scripts and documentation.
tagline: Automate visual media generation from structured text and prompts.

capabilities.title: Script-to-Video Compilation
capabilities.description: Transforms markdown technical guides into narrated, visually paced walkthrough videos.

capabilities.title: Dynamic Asset Injection
capabilities.description: Automatically inserts code snippets, product UI frames, and animated diagram highlights.

capabilities.title: Multi-resolution Rendering
capabilities.description: Simultaneous export for 16:9 desktop presentation and 9:16 vertical social reels.

capabilities.title: Full Audio Soundtrack Mastering
capabilities.description: Automated background audio ducking, sound effects, and voice clarity balancing.

name: RAG
shortDescription: Strict grounded-answer retrieval engine for tenant-isolated knowledge bases.
description: RAG knowledge system combining hybrid sparse-dense vector retrieval, re-ranking, and strict provenance citation. Designed to ingest PDF manuals, documentation, source code, and knowledge bases for strictly grounded answers.
tagline: Hallucination-free document intelligence with verifiable source attribution.

capabilities.title: Multi-format Document Ingestion
capabilities.description: Extracts clean semantic text from PDFs, Markdown, Notion, GitHub repos, and raw database dumps.

capabilities.title: Context-Aware Chunking
capabilities.description: Hierarchical chunking preserving headers, tables, and parent-child document relationships.

capabilities.title: Strict Provenance & Citations
capabilities.description: Every statement in the generated answer contains clickable footnotes pointing to exact source pages.

capabilities.title: Tenant-isolated Knowledge Partitioning
capabilities.description: Strict security boundaries guaranteeing that organizational knowledge never leaks across workspaces.

name: Telegram AI
shortDescription: Autonomous Telegram monitoring, lead classification and alert workflows.
description: Autonomous agent fleet monitoring targeted Telegram groups, channels, and forums. Extracts purchase intent, high-value technical queries, customer feedback, and breaking market signals with zero manual polling.
tagline: High-speed signal extraction from thousands of Telegram communities.

capabilities.title: Live Chat Stream Interception
capabilities.description: Listens across hundreds of community discussions simultaneously via distributed listener daemons.

capabilities.title: Fast Intent & Sentiment Scoring
capabilities.description: Filters noise, emojis, and spam, highlighting only high-value queries with commercial intent.

capabilities.title: Instant Dispatch & Webhooks
capabilities.description: Forwards actionable leads directly to manager Telegram accounts or CRM systems within 2 seconds.

capabilities.title: Automated Conversation Starter
capabilities.description: Can draft contextual introductory responses based on company knowledge for quick human approval.

name: Web Widget Support AI
shortDescription: Embeddable intelligent website chat widget with streaming answers, documentation grounding, and lead capture.
description: WEB WIDGET AI is a lightweight (<25KB), customizable embeddable web chat widget powered by streaming LLMs and vector RAG. It seamlessly integrates into any modern website or web app, answers visitor questions strictly grounded in your product documentation, collects verified leads, and hands off complex conversations to human operators.
tagline: Instant customer support and automated lead qualification embedded in any website.

capabilities.title: One-Line Script Embedding
capabilities.description: Drop onto any website via a single script tag across WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, React, Next.js or static HTML.

capabilities.title: Strict Knowledge Grounding
capabilities.description: Answers visitor inquiries strictly using verified documentation, pricing sheets, and FAQs with zero hallucination.

capabilities.title: Automated Lead Qualification
capabilities.description: Identifies high-intent visitors, collects verified emails and phone numbers, and routes leads directly to CRM or Telegram.

capabilities.title: Custom Brand & Theme Styling
capabilities.description: Fully customizable widget accents, launcher bubbles, welcome greetings, avatars, and tone of voice.

name: TELEGRAM Support BOT AI
shortDescription: Interactive conversational assistant for Telegram groups, channels and private chats with tool execution.
description: TELEGRAM CHATBOT AI is a production-grade conversational bot engineered for Telegram. It handles customer inquiries in direct messages, moderates and assists in community groups, understands voice notes and document uploads, and runs custom backend actions (order lookup, support ticketing, booking) through secure function calling.
tagline: Enterprise-grade conversational intelligence and workflow automation right inside Telegram.

capabilities.title: Group Moderation & Community Support
capabilities.description: Answers member questions in group discussions, detects spam, and responds either inline or via private messaging.

capabilities.title: Voice Note & Document Understanding
capabilities.description: Transcribes incoming voice messages with Whisper and analyzes uploaded PDF/photo documents with multimodal vision.

capabilities.title: Contextual Multi-Turn Memory
capabilities.description: Maintains long-term session memory for every user, remembering past interactions, preferences, and account IDs.

capabilities.title: Custom Tool & API Integrations
capabilities.description: Executes backend queries, order lookups, appointment scheduling, and CRM updates directly through chat buttons and commands.
